Name: Howl Pendragon Portrait and Sprite Redesign
Author: ccmeowcc
Description:
[heading][center][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS]About[/font][/size][/center]
[/heading]
[color=#6d9eeb][b]✨[/b] This edit includes redesigned [b]portraits[/b] and [b]sprites[/b] for Blonde Howl and Raven Howl. [b]✨[/b] [/color]
[code]Latest edit: I've added three new portrait and sprite styles, while keeping the original version as well. Choose whichever one you like best![/code]

This is [b]not a standalone mod[/b].

This download contains [b]only four edited PNG files[/b] based on [b]yirehi's original mod[/b], created and published with the author's permission.

To use these edits, you must first download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46247]the original mod[/url], then replace the corresponding PNG files with the ones provided in this download.

The original mod is required for these edits to work.

[center][line]
[/center]
[heading][center][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS]Installation[/font][/size][/center]
[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install Howl Pendragon (Custom NPC).[/*]
[*]Download this visual redesign. [/*]
[*]Extract the

[code].zip[/code]file. [/*]
[*]Open the extracted folder and copy all

[code].png[/code]files. [/*]
[*]Navigate to:
[code]Mods\[CP] Howl Pendragon NPC\Assets\images[/code][/*]
[*]Paste the files into the

[code]images[/code]folder and replace the original files when prompted.
Note: It's recommended to back up the original images folder before replacing the files.[/*]
[/list][line]
[center][color=#ff0000]
Please do not reupload or redistribute these edited files without my permission. [/color][/center]
[center][color=#ff0000]Please also respect the original author's permissions.[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
